name: whelkmail
description: whelkmail — Gmail-style webmail client for IMAP/SMTP mailboxes on Cloudflare
author: mlzog

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute mail-client --local --file=./db/migrations/001_labels_signatures.sql && wrangler d1 execute mail-client --local --file=./db/migrations/002_label_accounts_filters.sql && wrangler d1 execute mail-client --local --file=./db/migrations/003_unified_labels_account_label.sql && wrangler d1 execute mail-client --local --file=./db/migrations/004_contacts.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute mail-client --remote --file=./db/migrations/001_labels_signatures.sql && wrangler d1 execute mail-client --remote --file=./db/migrations/002_label_accounts_filters.sql && wrangler d1 execute mail-client --remote --file=./db/migrations/003_unified_labels_account_label.sql && wrangler d1 execute mail-client --remote --file=./db/migrations/004_contacts.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
